title: Highlight Ahmedabad Mill Strike 1918
definition: The Ahmedabad Mill Strike (1918) was the first hunger strike led by Mahatma Gandhi in India, representing a pivotal shift in the nationalist movement toward organized labor activism and the application of Satyagraha in industrial disputes.
importanceInUpsc: It marks the transition of Gandhi from a regional leader (Champaran) to a national figure, demonstrating the efficacy of non-violent resistance in urban industrial settings and the birth of the Ahmedabad Textile Labour Association (Majoor Mahajan).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Highlight Ahmedabad Mill Strike 1918.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Rise of Industrial Capitalism in India
